title: Roswell Report source files - 733667-001-002
doc_notes: This document contains FAA investigation records and internal reports regarding the Japan Airlines Flight 1628 UAP sighting.

incidents.summary: Japan Airlines Flight 1628 reported unidentified traffic at its altitude, which was also tracked on the aircraft's weather radar and by ground radar centers.
incidents.location_name: en route from Keflavik to Anchorage
incidents.quote: the captain of Flight 1628 reported traffic at his altitude 1 mile in front of his aircraft
